Fluffy Pancakes

Yield: 8 pancakes

Ingredients
- 1½ cups (190 g) all-purpose flour
- 2 tablespoons (25 g) sugar
- 2 teaspoons baking powder
- ¼ teaspoon salt
- 1 cup (240 ml) milk
- 1 large egg
- 3 tablespoons (45 g) butter, melted

Preparation
1. Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
2. Whisk in the milk, egg and melted butter until just combined.
3. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium. Ladle the batter into the pan, about ¼ cup at a time.
4. Cook about 2 minutes per side, until golden and puffed.
